entries.name: Tom Cornell

expected.charges: Destruction of Selective Service registration certificate (50 U.S.C.
expected.sentence: Six-month sentence for draft-card burning; sentenced June 26, 1968 and surrendered in August 1968 after appeals. This was not continuous imprisonment beginning in November 1965. Exact release remains unverified. Sources differ on actual time served, so the sentence is not used as an exact duration.

updates.sentence: Six-month sentence for draft-card burning. Monica Ribar Cornell reported contemporaneously that he was taken into custody and began serving his sentence June 26, 1968. This supersedes a later photo caption giving August. The exact release date remains unverified; no release date is calculated from the sentence.
